description: This Java source file defines the TenantClientImpl class, which implements the TenantClient interface for interacting with Hono's Tenant API using Vertx-Proton for AMQP messaging. The class includes methods for creating tenant client instances, retrieving tenant data by ID or subject DN, and handling response caching and request-response messaging.
